owner_decision: Keep concise proofs in git; archive bulk diagnostics outside the tracked tree and verify the archive before removing loose copies.
verification: Every archived member matches its source SHA-256; every source was unchanged when verification completed.

removal.guard: Every loose file still matched its archived SHA-256, size and mode immediately before removal.

reference_resolution.member_name: The original repository-relative path is the archive member name.
reference_resolution.historical_records: Original invocation paths and raw observations remain unchanged. A missing diagnostic beneath this prefix is recoverable from the archive and member manifest.

retention_policy.tracked: Concise claim boundaries, essential failing/passing observations, replay sources, source snapshots and source-review conclusions.
retention_policy.archive_only: Repeated command captures and polling, full network traces, duplicated compiled drivers, stale mutation proposals and empty build/format streams.
retention_policy.future_runs: Keep bulk output outside the checkout. Commit a concise result with source identity, limits and an archive locator when raw diagnostics are needed.

limits: The archive is persistent local storage. No remote backup was created.
Removing tracked copies does not remove their objects from existing Git history.
No product source or test was removed. Baseline and full RFC completion remain unclaimed.
